GSE147092.note: Imported 2026-10-19 as two expression-survey reference sources, with no DE dataset added. Offline source replay verifies all 4,226,700 values across 28,950 genes; original versioned feature IDs and complete cell metadata are retained. See data/expression/oxt-reference/README.md. The reviewed author CENSUS matrix and annotations retain 146 PVN OXT cells: 125 final magnocellular and 21 parvocellular, with source animal/pool labels M3, M4 and M1-5. Cells are not independent animal replicates, and those labels do not establish a balanced replicated cell-type contrast. Preserve the deposited estimated mRNA-copies-per-cell unit, cell IDs, animal/pool labels and plate metadata. Sources: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE147092 and https://github.com/gofflab/OT_neuron_study_2020 (reviewed commit 39072fc7037398a8a2fd8abf63e685243355e3d3).

GSE318415.note: Reviewed 2026-10-19; spatial reference candidate, held from inferential contrast integration. Official GEO has three male C57BL/6 hypothalamus Xenium samples: GSM9494074 saline six weeks, GSM9494075 VPA six weeks and GSM9494076 VPA five weeks. The age-matched comparison is one sample per arm; the younger VPA sample does not supply another matched replicate. Spatial cells and transcripts cannot replace independent animals. No deposited OXT-treatment expression arm is established by these three sample labels. Source: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE318415.
